question: If (4y - (4)/(y)) = 13, find the value of (y² + (1)/(y²)).
solution:
Given

(4y - 4/y) = 13

Concept used

If (y - 1/y) = k

(y2 + 1/y2) = K2 + 2

Calculation

(4y - (4)/(y)) = 13

Dividing the whole equation by 4.

⇒ (y - 1/y) = 13/4
